package external

import "os"

type Box[T any] struct { Value T }
type Dependency struct { Value string }
type Foo struct { Value string }
var Calls int

func init() {
	if os.Getenv("ARC_BINDINGS_GENERATION") == "trap" {
		panic("generation executed the foreign package")
	}
}

func NewFoo(dependency Box[[]*Dependency]) *Foo {
	Calls++
	return &Foo{Value: dependency.Value[0].Value}
}
